newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan aims to cut 97/98 bond issues by Y4 trln - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan aims to cut 97/98 bond issues by Y4 trln - MOF.

text.p: The Japanese government will cut the amount of government bond issues in the next fiscal year by over three trillion yen from the previous year and aim at bringing the amount closer to four trillion yen, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Wednesday.
The ministry is now finalising a budget plan for the next fiscal year due out on Friday. The government will then adopt its budget plan on December 25.
Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto has vowed to make 1997/98 the "first year of fiscal reforms" by cutting issues of government bonds as much as possible.
In formulating the 1997/98 budget plan, foreign aid, defence and medical expenditures should not be treated as exceptions, Mitsuzuka said.
In the past, those areas escaped the budget axe as they were regarded as being "sacred".
